Q: Can I build a 45 m² modular home or granny flat in my back garden without planning permission?
A: Yes, since 27 July 2026, if you meet the Class 3A conditions in S.I. No. 340 of 2026. A detached habitable garden dwelling between 32 m² and 45 m² in the rear garden of a house is exempt from planning permission provided total garden structures do not exceed 45 m², the owner lives in the main house, it connects to the main house's services, it is not sold separately or used for short-term letting, you give the local council 14 days prior written notification with your Eircode, it meets Building Regulations, and work finishes by 31 December 2030. direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Can I build a 45 m² modular home or granny flat in my back garden without planning permission?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Yes, since 27 July 2026, if you meet the Class 3A conditions in S.I. No. 340 of 2026. A detached habitable garden dwelling between 32 m² and 45 m² in the rear garden of a house is exempt from planning permission provided total garden structures do not exceed 45 m², the owner lives in the main house, it connects to the main house's services, it is not sold separately or used for short-term letting, you give the local council 14 days prior written notification with your Eircode, it meets Building Regulations, and work finishes by 31 December 2030.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: What is the difference between Class 3 (30 m²) and Class 3A (32 to 45 m²)?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Class 3 (updated by S.I. No. 338 of 2026) covers non-habitable garden rooms, home offices, gyms and sheds up to 30 m² — you cannot sleep or live in a Class 3 room. Class 3A (S.I. No. 340 of 2026) covers a detached habitable garden dwelling (granny flat) of 32 m² to 45 m² with a kitchen, bathroom and bedroom.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How much does a modular building or garden dwelling cost in Ireland?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: An insulated, fitted garden office or room (12 to 30 m²) costs €18,000 to €55,000 including 13.5% VAT. A turnkey habitable 32 to 45 m² Class 3A modular dwelling with kitchen, shower room, foundations and service connections costs €65,000 to €135,000 (€2,400 to €3,200 a m²).

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Is VAT on a modular building 13.5% or 23%?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: When a modular builder supplies and installs the building on your site (under Revenue's two-thirds rule for construction services), the reduced 13.5% VAT rate applies. If you buy a supply-only flat-pack kit with no installation, it is taxed as goods at 23% VAT.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How long does a modular building take from order to completion?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Factory fabrication usually takes 4 to 8 weeks while your ground screws or concrete base and service trenches are prepared. On-site installation takes 1 to 3 days for a pre-assembled volumetric pod lifted in by crane, or 1 to 3 weeks for a panelised system assembled in the garden.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Who gets my enquiry when I fill in the form?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: One vetted modular building supplier that covers your county, and only one. They review your garden access, foundation options and service runs, and give you a written turnkey price.
